titulo: NASA’s SSPICY Mission to Demonstrate In-Space Inspection Technologies
cuerpo: A new NASA-supported spacecraft will get up close to satellites that are no longer in service, demonstrating technologies that could support future in-space repairs and reduce orbital debris.
